messages:
Anjali (PM): Quick sync — we need to decide if we shift next week's maintenance window to free capacity for a hotfix bundle or keep it and push smaller enhancements. Tradeoffs: maintenance shift = ~40% more GPU minutes next sprint, but delays feature A by 2 weeks. Input?
Tom (Eng): If maintenance moves, we can batch the KV cache flush and quantization rollout together. That saves ~30% ops time. :+1:
Kerry (SRE): Moving window increases risk surface for customer-facing deploys — we'll need a stricter canary. Recommend doing maintenance off-peak (Thu 02:00-06:00) if we must.
Marco (Product): Customer ask for enhancement (search recall tweak) is mild but high-touch for some early customers. Could we do a small ship now and schedule maintenance+hotfix next sprint?
Anjali (PM): Good point. Proposal: do a small targeted enhancement release (no infra changes) this week, and move maintenance to the sprint boundary to batch hotfix + infra work. Thoughts on capacity numbers?
Tom (Eng): Small enhancement requires ~8 GPU-hours. Hotfix bundle + quantization testing is ~72 GPU-hours. If we move maintenance, we can absorb hotfix without extra headcount.
Kerry (SRE): Canary plan for moved maintenance: stage -> 5% prod -> 20% -> 100% across 12h with rollback gates. Need on-call signups for Thu night.
Marco (Product): Sounds reasonable. Customer-facing enhancement gets shipped now; maintenance next sprint. We should promise a clear rollback plan to customers.
Anjali (PM): Action items: Tom to own enhancement deploy (ETA Tue EOD), Tom+Kerry to draft canary/rollback playbook for maintenance (due Fri), Marco to notify impacted customers about timing and rollback guarantees. :memo:
DevOps Bot: Reminder scheduled — create incident runbook template: `/create-runbook maintenance-178654`
Tom (Eng): I'll create the runbook and tag @Kerry. Also adding a small test matrix for quantized model runs in CI: `scripts/quant_test.sh --short`
Kerry (SRE): I'll take Thu night on-call for the roll and set up extra logs/alerts for KV flush lag.
Marco (Product): I'll draft a short customer note and share in #customer-success for review.
Anjali (PM): Agreement: ship enhancement now, move maintenance next sprint with hotfix bundle. If any blocker emerges, we reconsider. Closing this thread unless objections. :white_check_mark:
